Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the time earlier — appreciated the clear context on your latency targets and the compliance constraints around PHI. Quick recap and action items:

- Goal: run a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive / demo focused on a dedicated deployment pattern and streaming latency at 10ms/batch for typical clinical flows.
- Internal attendees suggested: Grace (AE), Aditya (Solutions), Neha (Infra lead for deployment patterns). Please let us know if you want any engineer from your side to demo production traces.

Two operational hiccups I noticed: your calendar invite didn't include an .ics attachment (seems like the invite never arrived in our mailbox) and the timezone on the stub I received showed CET while you mentioned PST on the call — I want to avoid any mixups. Also I saw the meeting URL in the thread got updated mid-send (old link pointed to a placeholder).

Can you confirm:
1) whether you received an invite from our side (I don't see one in my calendar) or if you prefer we send the official Google invite?
2) your preferred timezone for the deep-dive (we'll propose in PST and UTC).

Two windows that work on our side (all in PST):
- Tue, Dec 21 — 09:00–10:15 PST (17:00–18:15 UTC)
- Wed, Dec 22 — 13:00–14:15 PST (21:00–22:15 UTC)

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short pre-demo checklist (VPN/guest accounts, sample dataset access). If those windows don't work, share 2x 45–75 minute slots that do. Once we lock a slot I'll re-send a calendar invite with an .ics and a single canonical join link.

Best —
Grace O'Connor
